game.desc: I HAVE ALWAYS FOUGHT ALONE. But one man cannot defeat the entire templar order. So I have recruited my fellow Assassins. Together, we will cleanse the corruption from the holy city of Rome. Together, we will forge THE BROTHERHOOD.
